triggers.name: new_record
triggers.title: New record
triggers.help: Checks for new record in entity for every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: field_list
input.label: Fields to retrieve
input.hint: Improve recipe performance by selecting only the fields that are relevant to the recipe. All fields are returned in the data tree if left blank.

actions.name: create_batch_record
actions.title: Create records
actions.description: Create batch of records in OutSystems
actions.help: Creates a batch of up to 10000 records in the selected entity. Select the entity, then provide data for the records.

input.name: Id
input.label: Record ID
input.hint: Record ID can be found in the url.

actions.name: search_records
actions.title: Search records
actions.help: First select the module and entity you want to perform the search over. Then choose which entity fields you want to use in your filter. Lastly, specify the value those fields need to match in order for a record to be included in the result set. All records will be returned if no fields are given.

input.name: field_list
input.label: Fields to retrieve
input.hint: Improve recipe performance by selecting only the fields that are relevant to the recipe. All fields are returned in the data tree if left blank.
